title: 800 child labourers, 503 from Bengaluru alone, rescued in two-hour crackdown across Karnataka
description: In a Statewide crackdown on child labour on Saturday, police teams and Labour Department officials inspected 16,951 premises across Karnataka and rescued 800 children, all in a matter of two hours, with Bengaluru city alone accounting for 63% of the rescues, at 503
